_meta.convention: gate_kind describes how the handler itself decides applicability. 'none' = the handler never reads the build id; its installs are pattern-scanned (sub_10003830 / sub_1005AFA0) and therefore apply to every build whose bytes match, so all 12 builds are listed as recovered. 'inline' means the INI key is consumed inside the dispatcher sub_100523C0 and has NO dedicated handler function (handler field says so).
_meta.evidence_basis: Only 16 functions reference 0x1015BE04: DllMain, sub_10004850 (GTAC/bdebug helper), and 14 option handlers. Verified with two reads: xref_query(0x1015BE04) and search_text('1015BE04'). Only 7 functions reference dword_1015AD70 (the game module base used for absolute RVA writes): sub_1001B580, sub_100234E0, sub_100441B0, sub_10044710, sub_10044BD0, sub_10045490, sub_10046A10 (search_text('1015AD70', 97 hits)). Every other handler's sites are pattern-scanned.
